verses.1: For money has its uses, and gold has its place.
verses.2: Iron from the sky is taken away, and stone is quarried.
verses.3: He placed darkness there, and for every creature, it became a shelter from the sun and a shadow.
verses.4: A torrent of water flowed from those who were forgotten by God; they were deprived of human dignity.
verses.5: From this land, bread is produced. And beneath it, it becomes like fire.
verses.6: Its stones are of precious stones, and its surface is covered with gold.
verses.7: A path that no one knows, and whose path cannot be seen by anyone.
verses.8: The sons of Shachatz did not guide him; they did not even pay attention to him at all.
verses.9: In that dream, he stretched out his hand, turning the mountains into dust.
verses.10: In the caves, there were stars everywhere, and everything that was valuable could be seen with his eyes.
verses.11: From the springs of Hibesh, light and darkness emanate.
verses.12: And wisdom can be found from afar; and that place is in the middle.
verses.13: Man does not know its value, and it will never be found in the land of living beings.
verses.14: He said, “It isn’t me.” And the sea said, “There’s no one with me.”
verses.15: She shall not be bound under any kind of restraint, nor shall her price be measured in gold.
verses.16: It shall not be sold in a market or traded in any place where it is valuable and rare.
verses.17: It shall not be adorned with gold or jewels; its value and worth are nothing in comparison.
verses.18: Waters and clouds will not be remembered, nor will wisdom from the pearls.
verses.19: It shall not be allowed to grow weeds in its sacred land; it shall not be cultivated at all.
verses.20: And the wisdom will come from above. And that place is in the middle.
verses.21: And it disappeared from the eyes of all living things, and from the heavens it was hidden away.
verses.22: Abdon and Mawet said, “In our ears we heard their voices.”
verses.23: God understands her ways, and He knows her location.
verses.24: For he will look down from the ends of the earth, and see all under heaven.
verses.25: To make them into a “wind” that can carry weight and water in its flight.
verses.26: In his actions, he follows the laws and rules of righteousness.
verses.27: Then she saw and reported on her preparations and also her research.
verses.28: And he said to Adam, “These are the qualities of wisdom: fear of God and the ability to avoid evil.”
